svg.title: Noctiluca mobile layout
svg.desc: Illustrative phone mockups drawn from the real layout: the surface of the map with the hero and dock, the jump to episode sheet, and a solved level with the editor, output and symbol row.
svg.text: Built for a thumb and a small screen.

svg.text: The map opens at the bottom, so level 001, your
progress and the dock are in reach.
A bottom sheet with fifty chips. Each shows its tint
and a fill bar for progress.
A symbol row and the actions ride above the
